cases.description: Frame a new cycle with no delegation: step 1 (request and scope) must end at its gate.
cases.prompt: Use the nstart skill. I want to add a slugify function to textkit that turns titles into URL slugs, with an optional max length, and expose it on the command line like normalize.

checks.label: brief.md was not written past the first gate

judge: The agent proposed numbered objectives (O1, O2, ...) and non-goals, and asked the user to confirm them.
The agent did not design: no tasks, design decisions, or signatures beyond what the user's request already states.

cases.description: Frame a new cycle in one turn: the prompt delegates every step.
cases.prompt: Use the nstart skill. I want to add a slugify function to textkit that turns titles into URL slugs, with an optional max length, and expose it on the command line like normalize. I delegate every nstart step to you: don't wait for my approval.
judge: The Request section records the user's request in their own words, or quotes its key lines.
Every objective is cited by at least one step of the approach, and the approach is marked provisional.
Every skipped phase has a one-line reason.

cases.description: Artifacts from an earlier, finished cycle exist. nstart must ask whether to keep, archive, or delete them before writing.

judge: The agent noticed the leftover artifacts of the earlier strip_accents cycle and asked whether to keep, archive, or delete them.

cases.description: Frame a new cycle with a simulated user who sets the objectives and non-goals and declines Control.
cases.prompt: Use the nstart skill. I want to add a slugify function to textkit that turns titles into URL slugs, with an optional max length, and expose it on the command line like normalize.
cases.user_script: Your request is in your first message. Objectives: O1, the slugify function with an optional max length; O2, the slugify command-line subcommand. Non-goals: no third-party dependencies, and no transliteration of non-Latin scripts. Agree with the approach if it serves both objectives. Accept the agent's phase suggestions. When asked about a Control section, decline: leave it empty. When the agent says brief.md is written, reply <<DONE>>.

checks.label: brief.md was not written before the user's first reply

judge: The brief's objectives and non-goals match what the user said.
The agent asked once about a Control section, and left it empty after the user declined.

cases.description: Messy user: delegates one step (non-goals) mid-run and approves the rest. Each section must record who approved it.
cases.prompt: Use the nstart skill. I want to add a slugify function to textkit that turns titles into URL slugs, with an optional max length, and expose it on the command line like normalize.
cases.user_script: Your request is in your first message. Objectives: O1, the slugify function with an optional max length; O2, the slugify command-line subcommand. When the agent asks about non-goals, do not list any: say 'You pick the non-goals, I trust you on that one.' Agree with the approach if it serves both objectives. Accept the agent's phase suggestions. When asked about a Control section, decline. When the agent says brief.md is written, reply <<DONE>>.

checks.label: brief.md was not written before the user's first reply

judge: Only the Non-goals section is attributed to the agent (delegated); every other Approved line says user. (The template's `- nbuild: run` line carries no attribution by design.)
The agent did not treat the one delegation as covering other steps.

cases.description: Frame a new cycle with a simulated user who sets two focus topics in Control. The brief must record them in the user's words.
cases.prompt: Use the nstart skill. I want to add a slugify function to textkit that turns titles into URL slugs, with an optional max length, and expose it on the command line like normalize.
cases.user_script: Your request is in your first message. Objectives: O1, the slugify function with an optional max length; O2, the slugify command-line subcommand. Non-goals: no third-party dependencies, and no transliteration of non-Latin scripts. Agree with the approach if it serves both objectives. Accept the agent's phase suggestions. When asked about a Control section, set two focus topics: 'architecture: component boundaries and module dependencies' and 'naming: public names of modules, functions, and CLI flags'. No other overrides. When the agent says brief.md is written, reply <<DONE>>.

checks.label: brief.md was not written before the user's first reply

judge: Control lists exactly the user's two focus topics, each with what it covers, in the user's words; the agent added no topic of its own.
The agent still stopped at each nstart gate (objectives, non-goals, approach, phases): focus did not waive them.
